explanation: 家 places the roof-like 宀 over a 豕-like lower form. The older analysis connects the lower form with a pig in a dwelling; for modern study, keep that history separate from the everyday meanings ‘home’ and ‘family’.

glyph.title: 家
glyph.description: The character 家 is shown as a roof component above a compressed pig-like historical form.

components.note: This top component places the character in the world of dwellings and covered places.
The lower form is traditionally analyzed as 豕. It is a historical clue, not an active pig meaning in every modern use of 家.

explanation: 明 brings 日 and 月 together in a memorable image of light. That visible pairing is useful for learning, while the exact historical development is more complicated than the simple ‘sun plus moon’ story.

glyph.title: 明
glyph.description: The character 明 is divided into a sun component on the left and a moon component on the right.

components.note: The left side supplies a direct image of light and is also the dictionary radical.
The right side reinforces the learner-facing image of illumination.

shortGloss: An everyday word for one’s mother.
explanation: 妈 is a semantic–phonetic character. 女 points toward its meaning, while 马 (mǎ) offers the pronunciation family, even though its tone differs from mā.

glyph.title: 妈
glyph.description: The simplified character 妈 is divided into woman on the left and horse on the right.

components.note: The left component places the word in a female family relationship.
Here 马 primarily suggests sound rather than contributing the meaning ‘horse.’

explanation: 问 places 口, the mouth, inside 门. The mouth points to speaking and asking; 门 belongs to the sound family and creates the character’s enclosing visual structure.

glyph.title: 问
glyph.description: The simplified character 问 is shown as a mouth enclosed by a door component.

components.note: The outer form encloses the mouth and belongs to the character’s pronunciation history.
The inner mouth contributes the idea of speech and asking.

explanation: 东 is the simplified form of 東 and comes through cursive abbreviation. Its modern visible pieces are not a dependable meaning-plus-sound decomposition, so this page uses an explicitly visual split rather than inventing an etymology.

glyph.title: 东
glyph.description: The HanziVG glyph for 东 is divided into an upper frame and a 小-like lower group for practical inspection.

components.note: This group is only a convenient visible region. Do not read it as an independent semantic component.
HanziVG groups these three strokes as 小. Here that remains a visual grouping, not a claim that ‘small’ supplies the meaning of east.
